use_case_name: Use case: a single measurement channel degrades in service
preconditions: The pack is at a nominal state and the vehicle is stationary.
Both measurement channels are healthy at the start of the run.
A channel-degradation mechanism is available to the test.

main_success_scenario.action: A degradation begins on one measurement channel
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item detects the disagreement without being told

main_success_scenario.action: The item moves to its degraded mode
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: Contactor control is retained and the reduction is published to the vehicle control unit

main_success_scenario.action: The service technician inspects the item
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The technician can identify which channel degraded from the item's own output without external equipment

main_success_scenario.action: The degradation is repaired and cleared
main_success_scenario.expected_observable_outcome: The item returns to normal mode and the degraded indication clears

operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Pack at rest in a workshop, item powered, healthy pack
operational_scenarios.perturbation: The redundant channel is offset progressively beyond the plausibility envelope
operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: Enter degraded mode with monitoring rate increased and transfer limited, rather than opening the contactors
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Degraded state published; no safe-state reaction; technician can diagnose the affected channel
operational_scenarios.observable_by: The service technician and the vehicle manufacturer
operational_scenarios.safe_state_interaction: Deliberately not reached for a moderate degradation. Reaching it is the failure this scenario exists to detect, because an item that escalates every degradation is safe and useless.

operational_scenarios.operational_situation: Pack at rest in a workshop, degradation continues past the point of any usable reference
operational_scenarios.perturbation: The degraded channel is driven to a total loss of reference
operational_scenarios.expected_item_behaviour: Escalate to the safe state rather than continue on an unusable channel
operational_scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Contactors open; fault latched and diagnosable
operational_scenarios.safe_state_interaction: Reached. The boundary between the first scenario and this one is the degraded-to-fault threshold, and no numerical value for that boundary exists in this corpus.

postconditions: The channel is repaired and the item is back in normal mode.
The degraded indication has cleared and no fault entry remains latched.
limitations: The plausibility envelope that decides degraded versus fault is not numerically specified anywhere in the corpus, so the boundary this use case depends on does not exist yet as a checkable value.
No channel was degraded and no degradation was injected.
The service-technician diagnosability criterion has no agreed definition.
